_readme: THE config file — everything you might switch lives here. (1) Switch page: set pageId (or igUsername) + a FRESH metaUserToken (Graph API Explorer) and push; the agent mints the new page's permanent token on the next run and saves it to pageAccessToken automatically. (2) pageAccessToken: permanent page token — posting keeps working even after metaUserToken expires (page tokens never expire). (3) Pause everything: set autoPost to false (the GitHub Actions runner reads it live; force runs still work). (4) Schedule: slots + timezone (currently ONE post per day at 06:00 EAT). (5) IG catch-up window after slot time: graceMinutes (420 = 06:00-13:00 EAT, ending 10:00 UTC — the same window-END time Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali reliably posts within; the 06:00 EAT slot is the earliest of the three pages and GitHub drops most 03:00-07:00 UTC fires, so the window must contain the reliable 07:30-09:45 UTC landing cluster. Past it that day's IG is skipped — sibling pages force-rescue it the same afternoon, or the force button posts just the IG half manually). (6) Mutual rescue: 'siblings' lists the pages this agent watches — any landed run here dispatches a sibling whose IG half is due but has no landed run of its own (token: dispatchToken in this file — owner's PERMANENT PAT since 2026-10-07, never remove its repo scopes (the 10-05 scope loss silently killed the rescue net and caused missed posts on 10-01 and 10-07)).
